method: Boolean intersection of nominal rays with the actual enclosure/aperture STL meshes

checks.check: red LED and BPW34 are coaxial
red chief ray blocked by blank
red chief ray passes d2
red chief ray passes d5
red chief ray passes d16
red chief ray clear of body
red chief ray clear of lid
red chief ray clear of new_frame
red chief ray clear of d16_aperture
red cross-channel ray blocked by centre partition
ir LED and BPW34 are coaxial
ir chief ray blocked by blank
ir chief ray passes d2
ir chief ray passes d5
ir chief ray passes d16
ir chief ray clear of body
ir chief ray clear of lid
ir chief ray clear of new_frame
ir chief ray clear of d16_aperture
ir cross-channel ray blocked by centre partition

conclusion.nominal_alignment: Both LED axes pass through their aperture centres and the nominal BPW34 active-area centres.
conclusion.separation: The solid centre partition blocks a direct ray from either LED to the other photodiode.
conclusion.scope: This is a geometric line-of-sight result, not a measured optical-sensitivity or leakage result.

limitations: No LED radiant-power, scattering, reflection, print translucency or assembly-gap model.
Purchased BPW34 package and lead forming were not physically measured.
A physical dark-box leakage and signal-range test is still required.
